svg.title: Tracks of a recording during playback
svg.desc: Five tracks over two and a half minutes with checkpoints at every 30-second barrier. Tracks created later have empty checkpoints before their first packet. A viewer watching the nether seeks to 1:45: the timeline reads checkpoint 3 and the frames up to 1:45 of the global and the nether track. The overworld track is scanned for players only when the player list is requested, the state track of player A only when its state is requested, and the donkey's state track is not read.
svg.text: A viewer in the nether seeks to 1:45. Every track has a checkpoint at each barrier; playback reads only the tracks it needs.
empty checkpoint, before the track existed
